rejectedCandidates.reason: Contains raw personal historical data; only sanitized aggregate methodology and results are admitted.
Credential or secret key material is never admitted to the repository.
Rebuildable third-party dependencies and caches are excluded; manifests, locks, versions, and source links are retained instead.
Transient databases and rebuildable binaries are execution artifacts rather than durable authority.
Raw conversation-derived editor baselines are excluded; sanitized aggregate and benchmark protocol artifacts are retained.
Raw tool transcripts and copied private project fixtures are excluded; method and aggregate evidence are retained.
Confidentiality-sensitive packets are never inspected or admitted; the scope-control incident is retained without packet content.
